Modification Discription: create_dataset() and require_dataset() now accept parameters efile_prefix and virtual_prefix to set a filesystem path prefix to use to find files for external datasets and for virtual dataset sources (PR 2092). These only affect the current access; the prefix is not stored in the file.
Function Description: Create a new dataset. Options are explained in Creating datasets.

Modification Discription: New property Dataset.is_scale for checking if the dataset is a dimension scale
Function Description: Return True if the dataset is also a dimension scale, False otherwise.

Modification Discription: New out argument to read_direct_chunk() to allow passing the output buffer
Function Description: Reads data to a bytes array directly from a chunk at position specified by the offsets argument and bypasses any filters HDF5 would normally apply to the written data. However, the written data may be compressed or not.
